subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la air, water, soil, sunlight, forests, fuels matrum natural resources namma life-ku eppadi support pannudhu-nu paappom. Resources-ai responsible-aa use pannuradhu, conserve pannuradhu yen mukkiyam-nu purinjukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Natural resources-na enna-nu examples-oda solla mudiyum.
Air, water, sunlight life-ku yen essential-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Fresh water limited resource-nu describe panna mudiyum.
Forests matrum soil-oda benefits-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Fuels-oda uses matrum pollution impact-ai compare panna mudiyum.
Natural resources conserve panna practical actions suggest panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Natural resources namakku enna tharudhu?
teaching_sequence.caption: Water, air, soil, sunlight, forests ellam nature-lirundhu kidaikkura resources. Food, drinking water, shelter, energy, materials-ku ivai help pannum. Daily life-la use pannura natural resources-ai list pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Bhoomi-um Surya-vum Ajji veetla water, vegetables, air, sunlight eppadi use aagudhu-nu observe pannura madhiri imagine pannunga. Nature resources illama life kashtam.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Natural resource-na enna? Ungal daily life-la use aagura moonu natural resources sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Air, wind matrum water
teaching_sequence.caption: Air breathing-kku thevai; wind firki-ai rotate panna mudiyum. Water drinking, growing crops, cleaning, living organisms-ku essential. Resources use pannumbodhu waste avoid pannanum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Firki rotate aaguradhu wind movement nala. Water-ai tap open-aa vidaama, required amount mattum use pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Wind movement-ai kaattura oru example sollunga. Water-ai save panna oru habit enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Fresh water limited
teaching_sequence.caption: Earth-la water neraya irundhaalum, adhula perumbaguthi salty ocean water. Fresh water-oda small fraction mattum easy-aa access panna mudiyum. Groundwater, rivers, lakes-ai recharge panna rain, soil, vegetation mukkiyam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Tap water namakku easy-aa kidaikkudhu; aana ella region-layum same access illa. Water use-ai plan panni, leaks fix panni, rainwater collect panna mudiyum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Earth water-la easy-aa use panna mudiyura fresh water yen limited? Water conserve panna rendu ways sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Sunlight, forests matrum energy
teaching_sequence.caption: Sun Earth-ku main energy source. Plants sunlight use panni food prepare pannum; forests habitat, oxygen, timber, fruits, medicines matrum soil protection provide pannum. Forests biodiversity-ai support pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Forest products list pannumbodhu wood mattum illa; fruits, fibres, medicines, clean air, habitat ellam consider pannunga. Trees soil erosion-ai reduce pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Sunlight plants-ku eppadi help pannudhu? Forests provide pannura moonu benefits sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Soil formation matrum earthworms
teaching_sequence.caption: Soil rocks weather aaguradhu, organic matter mix aaguradhu moolama long time-la form aagum. Earthworms soil-ai loosen panni organic matter mix panna help pannum. Healthy soil plants grow aaga essential.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Earthworm soil-la tunnels create pannum; adhu air-um water-um move aaga help pannum. Earthworms natural soil helpers.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Soil form aaga enna processes help pannum? Earthworms soil-ku eppadi useful?

teaching_sequence.title: Fuels matrum pollution
teaching_sequence.caption: Wood, coal, petroleum, natural gas, LPG madhiri fuels energy provide pannum. Burning fuels pollution create pannalaam; some fuels cleaner than others, aana all fuel use-kum impact irukkum. Energy save pannuradhu pollution reduce panna help pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Traditional fuels-um modern fuels-um compare pannunga. LPG, natural gas use panninaalum ventilation and safety mukkiyam; fuel waste panna koodadhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Oru fuel example sollunga. Fuel burning nala varra oru environmental impact enna?

teaching_sequence.title: Natural resources protect pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Air, water, soil, forests, rocks, fuels ellam natural resources. Renewable resources replenish aagalaam; non-renewable resources limited and form aaga long time edukum. Reduce, reuse, recycle, conserve water, plant native trees madhiri actions help pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Natural resources free-aa kidaikkudhu-nu waste panna koodadhu. Namma daily choices future generations-kum resources irukka help pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Renewable-um non-renewable-um eppadi different? Veettil resource save panna rendu actions sollunga.
